name: Translation
description: Instant translation workbench (MVP): built-in free engine, OpenAI-compatible LLMs, and optional DataWise host AI. Translate-as-you-type, streaming, engine management, history. Engines/secrets live in the plugin data directory (SQLite).

contributions.label: Translation workspace
contributions.description: Create a workspace with any name, then open the workbench. A free engine works out of the box — no API key on this form. Add OpenAI-compatible engines or use DataWise host AI inside the workbench.

fields.label: Workspace name
fields.description: Shown in the connection list. Engines and API keys are configured inside the workbench.

contributions.label: Send SQL to Translation
contributions.description: Load the current result SQL into the Translation workbench

zh-CN.name: Translation 即时翻译
